newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Newmont, Barrick cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Newmont, Barrick cut.

text.p: -- Goldman Sachs analyst Amy Gassman said she downgraded Newmont Mining Corp to market outperform from trading buy and cut Barrick Gold Corp to market perform from market outperform.
-- "Gold prices are at key technical support levels and there may be additional price pressures," she said.
-- She added that should gold prices fall below support, large liquid concerns like Newmont and Barrick may come under pressure.
-- Newmont was unchanged at 46 and Barrick was up 1/4 to 25-3/4 in U.S. trading.
